title: The Transformation-Response Framework: An Operational Reformulation of Quantum Mechanics
summary: We present the transformation-response framework, an operational reformulation of quantum mechanics. A quantum state is not a Hilbert space object but the catalog of a system's responses to all physical transformations: for each operation $g$ from the system's local group $G$, an interference experiment gives a complex value $χ(g)$. The collection $\{χ(g): g\in G \}$ is the characteristic function and defines the state.
